items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Mr. ---the man who taught me music, Mr. Eugene Mikell was a teacher... I'm very thankful to Mr. Eugene Mikell for giving me a very good theoretical musical education.

ctx.x: Let me just take you back, so I can get the dates here straight. So, were you associated with that band at all or just knew about it?
No. I knew about it for the simple reason that Mr. ---the man who taught me music, Mr. Eugene Mikell was a teacher, one of the teachers of the Jenkins Orphanage.
